title: Your First Weekend at Linfield University, Shared as Cards
description: A practical arrival-to-Sunday sequence mixing orientation landmarks, campus resources, free exhibits, downtown public spaces and one ticketed McMinnville excursion.

cards.title: Start at Founders Way
cards.subtitle: Arrival stop · Thursday morning
cards.notes: Follow your assigned arrival time, complete check-in and move-in, then save the route so you can retrace it without luggage.
cards.short_summary: Use Linfield’s designated new-student arrival point to begin the weekend in the right place.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield’s Fall 2026 arrival schedule assigns new and transfer students to check in along Founders Way on August 27 from 9 a.m. to noon.
cards.access_notes: Follow the specific check-in time Linfield sends; the published arrival schedule says details remain subject to change.

cards.title: Learn the Riley Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Campus-services stop · Thursday afternoon
cards.notes: Locate Student Activities, the bookstore and Campus Information Center now; knowing this building reduces first-week navigation friction.
cards.short_summary: Orient yourself around a central building that gathers student organizations and everyday campus services.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield’s campus map places ASLU, the bookstore, Student Activities, Wildcat Events Board, a game room and other services in Riley Campus Center.
cards.access_notes: Building and service access can vary during orientation; consult the current orientation schedule and posted signs.

cards.title: Find Your Dining Base
cards.subtitle: Meal stop · Friday
cards.notes: Walk the route from your residence hall, review the serving stations and ask staff directly about dietary or meal-plan questions.
cards.short_summary: Make the central dining facility familiar before the regular class-week routine begins.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield identifies Dillin Hall as the central dining facility where students living on campus eat most meals.
cards.access_notes: Meal access depends on the current dining schedule and the student’s meal plan; verify both before going.

cards.title: Read a Student-Curated Exhibit
cards.subtitle: Culture stop · Friday afternoon
cards.notes: Enter Walker Hall before closing and examine one case closely; use its labels to see how Linfield students interpret objects.
cards.short_summary: See rotating exhibits prepared by students inside Walker Hall during a self-guided visit.
cards.evidence_claim: The Linfield Anthropology Museum displays changing student-curated cases on Walker Hall’s first floor and offers free, self-guided admission Monday through Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published visiting hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; the exhibits are self-guided.

cards.title: Pause in the Oak Grove
cards.subtitle: Outdoor reset · Friday evening
cards.notes: Use the space for a quiet reset after scheduled sessions, and note its position between Riley Campus Center and the President’s House.
cards.short_summary: Anchor your mental campus map with the named green used for major university gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield identifies the Commencement Green in the Oak Grove as lying between Riley Campus Center and the President’s House.
cards.source_title: Know Before You Go | Linfield University
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor campus space; scheduled university events may temporarily affect access.

cards.title: Open Saturday with Art
cards.subtitle: Gallery stop · Saturday noon
cards.notes: Arrive after the posted noon opening, view the current exhibition and leave time to walk the surrounding Arts Quad.
cards.short_summary: Begin Saturday with a free public exhibition in the Miller Fine Arts Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Linfield Art Gallery presents solo, group and student exhibitions, is free and open to the public, and lists Saturday hours of noon–5 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published Saturday hours are noon–5 p.m.; check the page for the current exhibition before visiting.

cards.title: Set Up Your Library Routine
cards.subtitle: Academic stop · Saturday afternoon
cards.notes: Find the service desk and one workable study area, then record the academic-term hours before your first full week begins.
cards.short_summary: Turn a brief weekend visit into a useful rehearsal for future study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield lists Jereld R. Nicholson Library on the McMinnville campus with academic-term Saturday hours of 10 a.m.–4 p.m. for students, faculty and staff.
cards.access_notes: Student academic-term hours list Saturday 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; hours are subject to change and break hours differ.

cards.title: Meet the Town Library
cards.subtitle: Community stop · Saturday afternoon
cards.notes: Walk through both public levels, note the service desks and ask what identification is needed before applying for a library card.
cards.short_summary: Add a downtown public study and community resource to your new-student map.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of McMinnville lists the McMinnville Public Library at 225 NW Adams Street and publishes Saturday hours of 10 a.m.–5 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published Saturday hours are 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; borrowing privileges may require registration or a qualifying library card.

cards.title: Take a City Park Break
cards.subtitle: Downtown outdoor stop · Saturday evening
cards.notes: Follow the public paths, look for the Soper Fountain and use the lawns for a low-key pause before returning to campus.
cards.short_summary: Connect the downtown library area with a longstanding civic green space beside Cozine Creek.
cards.evidence_claim: McMinnville’s official City Park page describes shady lawns, play areas, swimming and quiet reading spots, and documents the park’s Soper Fountain.
cards.access_notes: Use designated public paths and observe posted park or facility rules; Aquatic Center admission is separate.

cards.title: Finish Beneath the Spruce Goose
cards.subtitle: Ticketed excursion · Sunday
cards.notes: Arrange transportation before leaving campus, budget for admission and prioritize the aircraft or spacecraft you most want to examine.
cards.short_summary: Close the weekend with McMinnville’s large aviation-and-space collection southeast of town.
cards.evidence_claim: Evergreen Aviation & Space Museum displays more than 150 aircraft, spacecraft and exhibits, including the Spruce Goose, and is open daily from 9 a.m.–5 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The museum lists daily hours of 9 a.m.–5 p.m., specified holiday closures and a location 3.5 miles southeast of McMinnville.
